1 · Intro

When to use it.

Oracle has two ways to end work. End Assignment stops one job. Terminate Employment ends the whole work relationship and every assignment in it.

Picking the wrong one either leaves a job running that should have stopped, or stops a job the person is keeping.

Use this whenSomeone is leaving a job and you need to decide whether they are leaving one job or leaving Vanderbilt employment.

Watch-outs

  • Terminating someone who keeps another job stops pay for that job too. Check assignments before you terminate.
  • Open item: confirm which End Assignment entry point Vanderbilt uses (Change Assignment > End Assignment or the termination page), since it depends on the termination version configured.

HCM Academy job aid · Offboarding

Ending assignments vs. terminating employment

Use when: Someone is leaving a job and you need to decide whether they are leaving one job or leaving Vanderbilt employment. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Count the person's assignments in Employment Info.
  2. Leaving everything? Use Terminate Employment.
  3. Keeping at least one job? End only the job that stops.
  4. Ending the only assignment? You must terminate.
  5. Ending the primary assignment? Make another one primary first.
